name: Validate worker-reported Board commands mechanically
description:
Factory review recommendation 9 of 20.

## Context

The supervisor currently interprets worker command blocks using prose rules, leaving room for cross-Story writes or unsafe command interpretation.

## Acceptance criteria

- Add validation and a dry run for reported Board command blocks.
- Allow only supported commands for the worker’s Story; reject shell syntax and Stage Run mutations.
- Apply permitted changes through the CLI and hold Stage moves until the Stage Run has been finished as required.

Recheck the reviewed behavior against the current implementation and configuration before making changes. Update the relevant documentation, skill guidance and repository configuration together where applicable.

comments.author: sunny
comments.body: Correction plan accepted with one refinement: keep the native Plugin option + stories.move guard approach (no core Plugin-specific concept), but bind the precondition to the planned full Run reference: stage, attempt and startedAt, not timestamp alone. Use a compact validated representation for the Plugin-owned flag/input; ordinary moves without it stay unchanged. Require current-visit finished Run under the move lock, and reject stale/replaced Runs; do not let later transforms invalidate the condition unnoticed. Deny worker-supplied precondition flags. Reject incoming --blocked-by add/remove forms, including equals syntax; allow only physical writes to the worker's Story. Reproduce and preserve the original two failures in deterministic existing regression checks, including the full apply path interleaving (not only the direct guarded move) and byte-identical replacement Run/other Story after refusal. Same-clock/different-attempt or Stage reference must not authorize a new Run. Merge main preserving waitFor/runCommand/launcher additions and all existing blocker tests; keep ADR0045 and docs/ref copies coherent. Current suite98, do not exceed100. Run all four checks and updated agentic-tui scenarios, push existing PR139 only. Proceed.

comments.author: sunny
comments.body: PR139 review reproduced two merge blockers: applyBlock uses a finished Run snapshot to authorize a later move; replacing that Run with a running Run between the Comment and move still moves the Story and erases the replacement. Also, story-linking add TEST-1 --blocked-by TEST-2 submitted for TEST-1 writes the Story Linking bag on TEST-2. Corrections need regression checks for both cases and current-visit preconditions enforced at the actual mutation under the Data Root lock; a second unlocked read is insufficient. Continue existing PR139 and branch sunny/row-55-validate-worker-commands in /home/sgolovine/Projects/rowbly-worktrees/row-55. Local unpublished merge SHA: e5e5b14e092dd5ff4cfc7cf4788f6ebebab7e157. comments.author: sunny
comments.body: Supervisor accepted plan: Plan accepted with refinements. Reject the whole block before any mutation when any line is invalid; return every line's decision so supervisor can explicitly resubmit allowed lines. Keep bounded own-Story allowlist and never pass through a shell. Host runCommand must pin the opened Data Root and noninteractive JSON flags and reject caller-supplied root/global/interactive overrides, rather than relying only on the Software Factory parser; avoid arbitrary shell capability or recursion. Keep execution outside an enclosing mutation/lock so child commands don't deadlock; each child operation owns its lock. Document partial success on later runtime failure. Guard move using current-visit finished Stage Run; hold while running/absent, drop failed; do not silently lose returned held commands. Read-only dry-run changes nothing. Reserve ADR-0045 (0043 hold,0044 brief reserved) and recheck. Extend an existing test in test/plugins or agentWorkflows instead of new file; keep total suite <=100 (currently97), one representative failure contract. No worker-brief changes yet: ROW-63/66 template updates are opening PRs, so merge them first; add only necessary quoting note. Parent remains main; no stack without approval. Run/report all four checks and screenshot scenarios. Proceed.

comments.author: sunny
comments.body: Draft PR: https://github.com/sgolovine/rowbly/pull/139. Adds `rowbly software-factory apply <KEY> --file|--text <block> [--dry-run]`, which checks a worker-reported rowbly block without a shell and runs only allowed commands about that Story. It refuses the whole block before any change when a line names another Story, uses shell syntax, runs a software-factory command or passes options such as --data-root, --yes, --edit or --*-file. A move runs last and only after the Stage Run is finished: it is held while the Run is running or absent and dropped after it fails. Each allowed line runs as its own rowbly child process through the new PluginCommandEnv.runCommand, which pins the opened Data Root and --json --no-prompt, refuses root or global overrides and cannot run recursively; the first failing line stops the block and earlier lines stay applied. Recorded in ADR-0045, which amends ADR-0040. Docs, the factory skill, reference pages and one existing workflow test are updated; typecheck, lint, test:unit and test:cli pass.
